_note: SAFETY THRESHOLDS (v4, 26 Nov 2026). 'max' = Not safe (hard block); 'caution' = Take care (allowed, near the limit). From BOM, WA Department of Transport and Recfishwest guidance and common dive practice, choosing the cautious end. Wave limits use the swell reaching the spot (direction and shelter considered); rock platforms keep an any-direction limit. NOT reviewed on site by a safety professional — always judge conditions yourself. Estuary spots ignore wave limits.

thresholds.rationale: Very strong gusts — risk of being blown off jetties, groynes and walls
basis: BOM strong wind warning: 25–33 knots (45–60 km/h); gusts can be 40% stronger

thresholds.rationale: Large waves reaching the shore — single waves can be twice this

BOM / WA DoT: the biggest waves can be up to twice the forecast (significant) wave height
